verdict.rationale: Drata's v2 API reference is hosted under /openapi/reference/v2/ paths, which suggests it is generated from an OpenAPI spec. However, no evidence documents a downloadable machine-readable spec file. The probe found that every standard spec path (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404, and Drata never claimed such a download, so this is no support rather than a dispute.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
